desc: Derive and prove the fixed-\(S\) feasibility condition, including the bound that every known \(A_i\) must satisfy \(A_i\le S\).
Prove that the required number of matches between known \(A\) and known \(B\) is \(K=\#A_{\text{known}}+\#B_{\text{known}}-N\), and that \(K\le0\) implies immediate feasibility.
Design the \(O(N^2)\) weighted pair-sum enumeration over distinct values, respecting \(S\ge\max\) known value and duplicate multiplicities.
Validate the algorithm on all samples and edge cases, then implement stdin parsing and exact `Yes`/`No` output.
